text:
hana (Design): Quick callout on Roles matrix -> Invite flow. When org SSO is enabled the invite modal greys out role selector and shows 'SSO enforced'. Users keep opening support tickets asking how to change the role.
omar (PM): saw 2 tickets last week. We should make the path to IdP settings obvious. Maybe a small inline link to provisioning docs.
tia (FE): current markup is a disabled <select>. Problem: disabled controls are skipped by keyboard and screen readers. We should replace with a read-only row and an info button.
maya (A11y): agree — disabled select is bad. Make the info control focusable, provide aria-describedby pointing to the explainer, and ensure dialog uses aria-labelledby. Also check color contrast for helper text.
ohana (Design): (typo) meant hana: proposed copy under email field: "Invited users receive the role defined by your SSO provider." Info button opens: header 'SSO-managed roles' body 'Your IdP controls role assignments. To change defaults, update provisioning/mapping in your identity provider.' Link: 'SSO provisioning docs'.
omar (PM): prefer 'View provisioning docs' CTA in the dialog. Add small toast after invites: 'If you need a different role, ask your IdP admin' — reduces tickets.
tia (FE): I'll implement read-only row + dialog. Sample button attrs: <button aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="sso-help">i</button>. Will ensure tabindex=0. Need final doc link.
maya (A11y): also request keyboard-only sanity check before merging. I'll run axe once it's up on staging.
ci-bot: build preview deployed to staging at 2026-03-25T11:02Z for branch fix/invite-sso-copy :rocket:
omar (PM): thanks all — targeting merge today. Hana, drop the final mock in the ticket and I'll route QA.
hana (Design): done, mock attached in the ticket.
